description: PictoGlyph multi-script and contextual research source catalogue v2. Compatible with download_sources.py v2; ready means a supported retrieval mechanism, NOT proof of download success, image inclusion, rights clearance, or scholarly correctness. review entries must be handled separately. Never treat sources with ambiguous decipherments as ground-truth translations.

sources.label: MMM Egyptian isolated signs
sources.licence: CC BY-SA 4.0 (dataset publisher)
sources.caution: Gardiner-coded sign images. Google Drive may limit anonymous downloads.

sources.label: MEH full page hieroglyphs and bounding boxes
sources.licence: CC BY-SA 4.0 (dataset publisher)
sources.caution: Segmentation data; includes source images and sign boxes.

sources.label: MuMMy multimodal hieroglyph data
sources.licence: CC BY-SA 4.0 (dataset publisher)
sources.caution: Hieroglyph images + Gardiner sequence/transliteration/translation.

sources.label: KanjiVG stroke-level vector signs
sources.licence: CC BY-SA 3.0
sources.caution: Modern idealized vector forms, not archaeological photographs. Render SVG to raster only in a later preprocessing stage.

sources.label: Coptic SCRIPTORIUM corpora
sources.licence: Per-document CC BY or CC BY-SA with exceptions; check every file
sources.caution: Text/transcriptions, not consistently manuscript-image crops; includes duplicate witnesses.

sources.label: Perseus Ancient Greek linguistic treebanks
sources.licence: Review licence per dataset/file
sources.caution: Primarily text and linguistic annotations, not inscribed glyph photographs.

sources.label: Lipi Indus inscriptions and sign references
sources.licence: Inspect repository and third-party corpus rights before redistribution
sources.caution: GitHub snapshot includes thousands of JPG seal images under public/seal_images; these are full seals, NOT automatically isolated glyph crops or gold sign labels. Site README claims a decipherment; this is not accepted scholarly ground truth. Check image copyright and source attribution before using.

sources.label: Linear A cross-referenced corpus
sources.licence: Check data manifests and source field rights; not a blanket image licence
sources.caution: Snapshot is valuable for 1,884 inscription records and metadata but contains no JPG/PNG/SVG images. Contains mixed licences at record/path level; verify restrictions before use, and obtain glyph images separately.

sources.label: Cretan Hieroglyphic Explorer
sources.licence: Review corpus/data rights
sources.caution: GitHub snapshot includes thousands of JPG images under _site/images, but also generated website assets and possible duplicates. Distinguish inscriptions, facsimiles, individual signs and unrelated images; check original authorship/licences.

sources.label: PASP Database for scripts on Cyprus
sources.licence: CC0 (Dataverse catalogue)
sources.caution: Includes Cypro-Minoan alongside other Cypriot writing; inspect file selection and IDs before automating.

sources.label: Bonn Maya Hieroglyphic Text and Image Archive
sources.licence: Check rights for each image and bulk/API access
sources.caution: Research archive with images and artefact context, but no verified bulk-download interface.

sources.label: Proto-Sinaitic / Serabit el-Khadim epigraphy
sources.licence: Object/image-specific
sources.caution: No verified standardised, openly licensed bulk glyph corpus; prioritise scholarly site catalogues and selected museum objects.

sources.label: Invisible East Digital Corpus (Sogdian and others)
sources.licence: Check record and individual referenced image rights
sources.caution: JSON release contains multilingual documents, not necessarily images bundled; filter Sogdian records.

sources.label: CDLI catalogue and ATF bulk dump
sources.licence: Inspect CDLI terms and images separately
sources.caution: Git LFS archives; historical GitHub dump may be stale (README says Aug 2022). Requires LFS or current CDLI exports.

sources.label: Meroitic inscription corpus discovery
sources.licence: Unverified
sources.caution: Secondary catalogue mentions a Meroitic corpus repository but independent download and provenance are not confirmed; do not use unreviewed speculative decipherments as labels.

sources.label: Byblos pseudo-hieroglyphic corpus
sources.licence: Research/edition-specific; verify images
sources.caution: Very small, poorly understood corpus. No verified bulk licensed image set.

sources.label: eDiAna Anatolian hieroglyphic Luwian corpus
sources.licence: Check database/image reuse and access permissions
sources.caution: Contains Hieroglyphic Luwian among several languages; bulk export unverified.

sources.label: Rosetta Stone — three-script translation key
sources.licence: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 for linked British Museum image
sources.caution: Rosetta is an artefact, not a script. Use as aligned evidence with explicit passage/line correspondence.

sources.label: Pleiades historical place gazetteer
sources.licence: CC BY 3.0
sources.caution: Snapshot changes; SHA256 and date recorded. Supports place/time plausibility, not evidence of contact on its own.

sources.label: Itiner-e ancient Roman road network
sources.licence: CC BY 4.0
sources.caution: Historical road topology and uncertainty; a possible route is not proof of a journey or exchange.

sources.label: Oxford Roman Economy shipwrecks and cargo
sources.licence: Verify redistribution terms on Oxford site
sources.caution: Some locations intentionally imprecise, dates uncertain, some origin/destination inferred.

sources.label: Roman Open Data / CEIPAC amphorae and inscriptions
sources.licence: Check dataset/API access and reuse permissions
sources.caution: Strong lead for commodities and traded amphorae; bulk method not confirmed.

sources.label: Stanford ORBIS Roman network model
sources.licence: Check data and model reuse
sources.caution: Modeled travel times/costs, not an observed historical itinerary.

sources.label: DeepScribe Elamite cuneiform sample images and annotations/code
sources.licence: Repository code GPL-3.0; check DATASET_LICENSE.md separately for image/annotation reuse
sources.caution: This GitHub ZIP is code plus sample images, NOT the complete Persepolis archive. Original labelled images are a separate externally hosted download; do not conflate code and dataset rights.

sources.label: Persepolis Fortification Archive labeled tablets/hotspots (DeepScribe)
sources.licence: Dataset licence specified in DATASET_LICENSE.md; image rights distinct from code
sources.caution: Download link is external to GitHub and requires a separate verified retrieval method. Expected files are ImagesWithHotspots.json, images/, categories.txt. Archive includes economic/commodities context relevant to trade.

sources.label: PaPYrus Hieratic OCR 13,134 isolated sign image dataset
sources.licence: Verify Dataverse dataset licence, attributed facsimiles, and redistribution conditions
sources.caution: Harvard Dataverse contains multiple ZIP files; download individual dataset archives through Dataverse file IDs/API. Do not mistake the GitHub OCR code for the 13,134 image dataset.

sources.label: TWKM Classic Maya graph drawings and relational sign catalogue
sources.licence: Image drawings listed CC BY 4.0; other catalogue metadata license unconfirmed; consult dataset RIGHTS.md
sources.caution: Hugging Face Parquet is NOT handled by the existing GitHub/gdown downloader. Use hf download with --repo-type dataset; preserved complete catalogue is a research snapshot, not official TWKM or an entire inscription-image corpus.

sources.label: Semi-automatically Filtered OCR Cuneiform Signs metadata
sources.licence: Check record rights/licence and original image sources individually
sources.caution: One JSON file (annotations_output.json); metadata only, not a bundled large image corpus. Source is semi-automatically filtered, so labels should be audited.

sources.label: CDLI Canonical Text Services converted cuneiform transcriptions
sources.licence: Check CDLI corpus rights and textual source reuse per record
sources.caution: Repository contains converted transcriptions and source references, not archaeological sign photographs; can be substantial. Does not replace current live CDLI catalogue.

sources.label: LAPIS-GT labeled proper nouns in inscriptional sources
sources.licence: Check dataset record licence
sources.caution: Small ZIP file LAPIS-GT.zip contains annotated inscription text, not necessarily original stone/tablet photos. An explicit Zenodo file download is available, but the current zenodo downloader only selects JSON files.

sources.label: The Met Open Access collection and artefact image links
sources.licence: API Open Access images when isPublicDomain=true; object-by-object rights vary
sources.caution: Requires paginated API harvester for /public/collection/v1.1/search or per-object requests; GitHub MetObjects.csv uses Git LFS and can be stale. Downloading a GitHub repo ZIP will NOT provide the full CSV nor the artefact image files.

sources.label: Smithsonian public S3 bulk metadata index of holding units
sources.licence: CC0 only for explicitly designated records/assets; rights may vary
sources.caution: This downloads a 37-line index of unit index URLs only, not images or 11 million records. Use a separate throttled S3 manifest/NDJSON harvester later. Smithsonian GitHub repo was archived in 2026; current bulk data is S3.

sources.label: Smithsonian S3 bulk NDJSON records and linked images
sources.licence: Per-record CC0 designation for eligible media; metadata and other images have varied rights
sources.caution: Requires iterating unit index files then NDJSON files, with checkpoint/rate limits and rights filtering; current downloader cannot recurse S3 index pages. Index is a separate ready source.

sources.label: Open Context archaeological records, finds, findspots and media
sources.licence: Per-project data licensing, protection of sensitive archaeological sites; verify prior to bulk use
sources.caution: Offers JSON-LD paginated search and per-project CSV/GeoJSON exports, not a single canonical bulk ZIP for all archaeology. Scope relevant regions and epochs before harvesting.

sources.label: Oxford Roman Economy Project mines and mineral commodities
sources.licence: Verify permissions for data export, reuse and citation
sources.caution: Mines database complements shipwreck/cargo data, but no machine-readable bulk file was verified for automatic download. Do not assume a Roman-period connection is universally applicable.
